title: Garage, Near Downtown Broadway + Rooftop w/ Dining
description:
East Nashville townhome just 8 min to Downtown Broadway bars & 13 min from the Opry. Near top restaurants, breweries & shopping! Enjoy a cocktail on our Rooftop deck w/ lounge seating, a dining table & TV. Park in the garage or in the adjacent parking lot. TVs in the living room and 2 of the bedrooms. Each bedroom has a connecting bathroom. Upscale kitchen w/ seating at the island and a dining table. Near hotspots such as Highland Yards, Southern Grist Brewing, Mas Tacos, Kisser, Pharmacy Burger

The space
★ 3 Bedrooms, each with their own ensuite bathroom
★ 4 Beds - 2 King Beds, 1 Queen Bed, 1 Sofa Bed
★ 3 Full size bathrooms 
★ 1 Half size bathrooms 
★ Rooftop patio with lounge seating, an outdoor dining table & TV
★ Smart TVs in 2 bedrooms, living room & rooftop
★ Garage to park in plus additional parking in our parking lot
★ Kitchen island with seating

★ Walk to All People Coffee, Garage Sale Vintage, Highland Yards Shops & Boutiques, Kisser, The Wash, Southern Grist Brewing
★ 3 miles to the Downtown Broadway area

★ Full Length Mirrors
★ High-speed internet
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ Drip coffee machine + coffee provided
★ Adjustable thermostat
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes

BEDS: 
Bedroom 1: Queen Bed on 1st floor
Bedroom 2: King Bed on 3rd floor
Bedroom 3: King Bed on 3rd floor
Living Room: Sofa Bed

BATHROOMS:
Bathroom 1: Full-size with standing shower, connected to bedroom 1 on 1st floor
Bathroom 2: Full-size with double vanity and standing shower, connected to Bedroom 2 on 3rd floor  
Bathroom 3: Full-size with shower/tub combination, connected to Bedroom 3 on 3rd floor  
Bathroom 4: Half bath on main floor, off the kitchen/living area

NO parties or locals guests allowed to book this property. Only the number of guests listed with the reservation allowed at the property at all times. 

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this inviting, high-end home. Spend your downtime in the cozy living room or relax on our rooftop patio. The airport is only about 15 minutes away, and there are plenty of affordable Ubers, Lyft and taxis available. Our home is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer.

At SkyShare Management, hospitality is what we do best. With 15+ years of property management experience, we combine professionalism with a personal touch to make every stay effortless and enjoyable. Our team provides local recommendations to help you discover the best spots and hidden gems the city has to offer. Please reach out to us through messaging with any questions you may have!

Guest access

Other things to note
Nashville is growing at a quick rate. There may be some construction happening near the home. 

Early check in times selected through the app are not applicable. If you would like early check in, you must message us.
